classification.method: curated narrative classification based on human-rights primacy, local problem discovery, policy prototyping, multi-local validation, evidence-based generalization and bounded algorithmic support
classification.note: HUMAN dominates because dignity, participation, local lived experience, human responsibility and rights define the political system. LIGHT represents measurement, explainability, local prototype testing, cross-local validation, transparent policy memory and the transformation of verified local knowledge into broader public policy. DARK remains a small but necessary space for uncertainty, failed prototypes, unintended consequences and redesign.
